title: Very disappointing experience with myntra
text_original:
I had a very disappointing experience with Myntra and would genuinely recommend being careful before ordering from this app. I ordered a night suit around 4–5 August. When I received it, I was extremely disappointed with the quality. The fabric was very thin, uncomfortable, and felt irritating on the skin. The product was not at all as expected.
I immediately tried to initiate a return, but I was told that the product could not be returned because it was marked as a “cash”/non-returnable item. I don’t understand this policy because I had already paid the full amount for the order.
What made the experience even worse was the repeated change in the return timeline. Initially, I was told the return would be processed by 15 August, then it was changed to 20 August, and now it has been delayed again until 28 August.

This has been a very frustrating experience, especially when the product quality itself was so poor.
My personal experience with Myntra has been extremely disappointing. Please check the return policy and product details carefully before ordering. I personally would prefer other platforms like Amazon or Meesho for clothing purchases after this experience.
Very poor experience. Disappointed with the product quality and return service.

title: Myntra’s customer service is PATHETIC and HORRIBLE!!
text_original:
I ordered an expensive diesel brand wrist watch few days ago and when I received the order I found the additional leather strap was missing in the box. When I contacted Myntra’s customer care, I was told that I have to wait until 6th May 2019 only to know what will be the next action from Myntra. I received a message within 6days from Myntra that my product will be returned. However, I only wanted to have the leather strap back which was missing since I wanted to avoid further delay of having the complete product but to my dismay, when I called customer care on 6th I was assured on call that my product will be exchanged.
 I waited till 9th May but I didn’t receive any response hence I called to customer care again on 10th May and spoke to an executive who transferred call to their senior executive named LATHA, I found her to be extremely careless and irresponsible and she also insisted that the product can only be returned and refused to proceed further regarding my complaint and kept asking me if there is any other issue to discuss. I went through a lot of mental agony in this whole process and I request Myntra’s top level management to look into this and help me out.

It offers a wide range of clothing, footwear, and accessories from popular brands at affordable prices. The app and website are user-friendly, making it easy to browse, select, and purchase items. Myntra also has a hassle-free return and exchange policy, which makes shopping more convenient and stress-free. However, sometimes the sizes may vary depending on the brand, so it’s important to check the size chart before buying. Overall, Myntra provides a great shopping experience with quality products, good customer service, and attractive deals. I would definitely recommend it to anyone who loves online fashion shopping.

title: Getting worse day day by
text_original:
Myntra service quality has been consistently declining, especially in the past few months. What used to be a reliable and convenient platform has now become a frustrating experience for regular shoppers. Orders frequently get delayed without any clear communication or updated delivery timelines. In some cases, the expected delivery date is completely missing, leaving customers in the dark.
Worse still, the platform has developed a troubling pattern of sending incorrect or poor-quality items. There have been instances where customers order premium products, only to receive cheaper substitutes — sometimes without original tags, raising serious concerns about authenticity and quality control. It almost feels like the original branded product is retained in their warehouse, and a lower-grade item is shipped instead.
This not only undermines trust but also reflects poorly on Myntra’s handling of inventory and commitment to customer satisfaction. The return and refund process isn’t always smooth either, adding another layer of inconvenience. If you have plenty of time and patience, you might be able to navigate through these issues — but for most people, shopping on Myntra has gone from hassle-free to highly unreliable.
It’s disappointing to see a once-dependable platform fall short on the basics: timely delivery, product accuracy, and transparent communication.

title: “A Lesson in How Not To Treat Customers”
text_original: “Once upon a time, shopping with Myntra was a delight, a venture into the world of online fashion without risks. Returns? title: From being an amazing brand to a shady brand
text_original:
I had been a loyal customer for years, easily making purchases worth over a few lakhs, but Myntra’s customer policies have turned absolutely draconian over the last two years. I finally uninstalled the app over a year ago, and here is why:
* Failed Returns & Lost Money: I was delivered the wrong item. I shared the required photos, initiated a return, and the item was successfully picked up. However, due to an issue with their logistics partner, the return was not delivered back to them. Even though the system acknowledged the return request, they completely refused to refund me. I was left with no product (right or wrong) and had to absorb a shameless loss of ₹3.8K.
* Repeat Offense: I foolishly let the first incident pass, thinking it was a one-off system glitch. Then, the exact same cycle happened again.
While other e-commerce companies, even their parent company, Flipkart are continually making their customer policies better, Myntra is going down the drain. Their customer service is entirely bottlenecked by rigid, anti-consumer rules; agents just put their hands up and repeat, "We can't do anything else."
Highly disappointed. Save your money and shop elsewhere.

title: Use Myntra app❤️❤️❤️❤️
text_original:
I’ve been using the Myntra app for over 2 years now and it has genuinely become my go-to fashion app. The interface is super smooth, clean, and incredibly easy to navigate — even my mom who isn’t very tech-savvy finds it simple to use.
What I love the most:
•  Huge collection of original brands and trendy styles. From casual wear to ethnic, sportswear to party dresses — everything is available.
•  The filters are actually useful! Size, color, brand, price, discount % — I can find exactly what I want in seconds.
•  Lightning-fast search and excellent recommendations. It really understands my taste now.
•  Great offers and bank discounts almost every week. I’ve saved so much money during their End of Reason Sale and Big Billion Days.
•  Super convenient COD + easy returns. Return pickup is hassle-free and refunds are quick.
•  Quality of images and product descriptions are top-notch. What you see is almost always what you get.
•  Wishlist and “Save for later” features are perfect for tracking favorite items.
Delivery is usually on time (often earlier than promised), and the packaging is neat. Customer support is responsive too.
If you love fashion and want a premium yet affordable shopping experience, just download the Myntra app. You won’t regret it! 💖
Highly recommended! 5/5 🔥

title: Not just an app
text_original:
I’ve been using the Myntra app for quite some time now, and overall it’s a very convenient and reliable shopping app for fashion and lifestyle products. The app is easy to navigate, and finding clothes, footwear, or accessories doesn’t take much time. The filters for size, price, brand, and color are very helpful, especially when you know exactly what you’re looking for.

One thing I really like about Myntra is the wide variety of brands and frequent discounts. There are always sales going on, which makes shopping feel worth it. The product images and descriptions are detailed, and customer reviews help a lot in deciding whether to buy a product or not.

Delivery is usually on time, and the packaging is neat. Returns and exchanges are also quite smooth compared to many other apps, which gives confidence while ordering. Sometimes sizes or popular items go out of stock quickly, and during big sales the app can feel a little slow, but these are minor issues.

Overall, Myntra is a great app for online fashion shopping. It’s user-friendly, offers good deals, and provides a hassle-free shopping experience. I would definitely recommend it to anyone who enjoys shopping online for clothes and accessories.

title: Review
text_original: I've been using the Myntra app for a while now and overall, it's a great platform for fashion shopping. The user interface is clean and intuitive, making it easy to browse through a wide variety of clothing, accessories, and footwear across popular brands. The filters are especially helpful in narrowing down choices. One of the best features is the frequent sales and discount offers, along with quick delivery and smooth return/exchange processes. The app also remembers your preferences and sizes, which makes repeat shopping convenient. However, the app can sometimes feel a bit heavy or slow on lower-end devices, and there are occasional glitches during checkout or coupon application. Also, customer support via the app could be more responsive. Rating: 4.3/5

title: Been Ordering Since 2016. Today, I’m Done.
text_original:
I’ve been ordering from Myntra since 2016–17, and after what happened with my latest order, I genuinely cannot believe how badly this platform has deteriorated.

I ordered a pair of Roadster shoes. It took ages to arrive, and when I finally went to the shipment warehouse at my university mall to collect it, the staff were completely inattentive and acted like they couldn’t care less.

But the real shock came when I got back to my room and opened the package.

Instead of the Roadster shoes I ordered, I received some cheap-looking knockoffs from a completely different brand called “Amico.”

I immediately contacted customer support, only to be greeted by an absolutely useless chatbot. There was no straightforward option to speak to a real person. I had to click through an absurd number of menus just to reach an actual support agent.

And then, when I finally got there, the app itself started glitching. I couldn’t even upload a photo of the product I received. It just sat there endlessly saying “Uploading…”

This is not what you expect from a platform I’ve been trusting with my orders for nearly a decade.

Wrong product. Poor delivery experience. Unhelpful staff. A frustrating support system. And then an app that doesn’t even let you submit the evidence needed to resolve the issue.

Myntra, this is absolutely unacceptable.

After almost 10 years of ordering from you, this is the last time I’m using Myntra. You’ve completely lost my trust.

title: Myntra has turned into a scam, beware before ordering!
text_original:
I ordered a T-shirt from Myntra but received a lower instead. When I placed an exchange request and clearly selected the option “Received a different item,” the delivery person refused to take it back, saying they can only exchange if the product matches the original order. He told me to contact customer care.

After I raised a complaint, they said the issue would be resolved soon. Instead, they rejected my request, claiming they had sent the correct product. I complained again and shared clear pictures showing that I received a lower (XL size) instead of a T-shirt. Still, Myntra replied that they had verified the item after “quality check” — which makes no sense since the wrong product was packed in the first place.

When I escalated the issue again, Myntra suddenly blocked my account, preventing me from tracking orders, contacting support, or even getting a callback (since they now only allow contact through the app). It feels like they deliberately silence customers who question their integrity.

After checking their social media pages, I found many people facing the same issue — wrong products, rejected exchanges, and blocked accounts.

I’m deleting this app and will never shop here again. I’ll be using other trusted platforms instead. I’m also glad my brother turned down their offer for SDE-3, at least he won’t be associated with such an unethical company.

Myntra, please fix your broken processes and stop scamming your loyal customers.

title: Safety Risk, Zero Customer Support – Avoid This App
text_original:
I had a deeply disturbing experience with Myntra that goes beyond poor service — this is about customer safety.

I ordered a product and returned it due to fitting issues. The delivery associate checked the seal and brand tags at pickup and processed the refund. Everything was done as per protocol.

A day later, the same delivery associate started calling me repeatedly (6–7 times), accusing me of fraud and claiming I had returned a fake product. The item had already been out of my possession for over 24 hours. As a customer, I can only verify authenticity through seals and tags — which were intact.

Then the situation escalated. He demanded money and threatened to come to my house with people if I didn’t pay.

This is not just bad service — this is harassment and a serious safety concern.

I immediately tried contacting Myntra support through the app, calls, and email. There is no real customer support. Only chatbots and automated replies. No option to speak to a human. The system kept saying someone would contact me in 24–48 hours.

In a situation involving threats, 24–48 hours is unacceptable.

Despite sharing the delivery agent’s details, I received no immediate help. The situation escalated so quickly that I had to pay extra money just to protect my family.

Customers share their home addresses and trust these platforms. When something goes wrong, and there is no real support system, you are left completely vulnerable.

This was my last transaction with Myntra.

Avoid this app if you value your safety.

title: You have forever lost a loyal customer.
text_original:
I am really disappointed with the Myntra app. My account has been deactivated for almost a year, and despite repeatedly complaining, it has still not been reactivated. The reason given was “Clauses 4 and 13 of the Terms of Use,” but even after providing my explanation, there has been no resolution.
	1.	No Violation from My Side – I have always made timely payments for my purchases. I have never engaged in fraudulent activity, sold products, or shared harmful/illegal content. I have only used Myntra as a genuine buyer.
	2.	Lack of Transparency – The termination notice only referred to Clauses 4 and 13 without explaining the specific reason or providing any evidence. This is not a fair justification for suspending a loyal customer’s account.
	3.	Order & Payment History – I have consistently paid for my purchases. Many times, I didn’t even return defective products just out of convenience. This shows I have never misused the service.
	4.	Violation of Consumer Rights – Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, customers are entitled to fairness, transparency, and protection against arbitrary denial of service. Terminating my account without valid reasoning is an unfair trade practice.

To make matters worse, customer service is extremely unhelpful. They only send emails with no clear solution and once even called me just to say, “You haven’t been using the app for a long time.” That doesn’t make sense since they deactivated my account in the first place.

Myntra may be a good shopping app, but the customer service is very poor. You have forever lost a loyal customer.

title: Disappointing Experience with Myntra's Return Process
text_original:
I recently ordered a kurti from Myntra and my experience has been far from satisfactory. I initially ordered a white kurti but received a black one instead. As soon as the kurti arrived, I opened the package and immediately applied for a return within two minutes.

It’s been almost six days now, and the return process has not been initiated. Despite receiving constant SMS notifications, no one has come to pick up the kurti. Every day, the status updates with “we were not able to pick up today,” which is incredibly frustrating.

In the past, Myntra’s return and exchange process was efficient and hassle-free. Unfortunately, it seems that things have changed, and the process has become complicated and time-consuming. I’m disappointed with the lack of prompt service and the overall experience. I hope Myntra improves their return policy soon.

I trust that you will address this complaint urgently and provide a satisfactory resolution. Your prompt response and actions are eagerly anticipated.

title: The new update to display ads for a specific search filter is the worst update, please take it down.

While I understand that this strategy can generate revenue, it’s important for Myntra to prioritize customer experience as well. When customers search with specific filters, they are often ready to make a purchase. As a Product Manager, I understand the intentions behind this update, but I believe the architecture, planning, and execution do not align with the best market standards.

Additionally, the logic for displaying ads aligned to the search category of the customer does not function as intended.

title: Worst customer support

title: Unfair trade practices
text_original:
I had a terrible experience with Myntra’s return policy, which turned out to be completely misleading. They advertise a “14-day easy return policy”, but when I tried to return a product, they refused to arrange a pickup without any valid reason.
	•	Fake “Non-Serviceable” Excuse: My address is regularly serviced by Myntra for deliveries, and past return pickups were successful. However, they are now falsely claiming that my address is “not serviceable” with no explanation.
	•	Forcing Customers to Self-Ship: They are making me self-ship the product at my own cost, something that was never mentioned at the time of purchase.
	•	Unfair Refund Policy: Instead of refunding my money to the original payment source, they are forcing a refund in Myntra credit—trapping customers into shopping again.
	•	Unjust Platform Fee Deduction: They deducted platform fees from my refund but still refused to arrange a pickup, making me pay for return shipping.
	•	Pathetic Customer Support: Despite multiple follow-ups, Myntra’s team has provided no solution and keeps repeating the same scripted response.

I have raised a complaint with the consumer court, sent a legal notice, and posted about this issue on social media. Despite this, Myntra continues to ignore my complaint. On social media, they only reply with “We have highlighted your concern and will get back to you soon”, but in reality, they keep giving the same scripted response with no resolution.

🚨 Beware before shopping on Myntra! Their return policy is misleading, and their customer service is unhelpful. Even legal action and public complaints are ignored.

From trendy apparel to stylish accessories, this app offers an extensive range of products that cater to every fashion need. The user interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, ensuring a seamless browsing experience. The app's search functionality is robust, allowing users to quickly find what they're looking for. With secure payment options and hassle-free returns, Myntra ensures peace of mind with every purchase. Whether you're on the hunt for the latest fashion trends or timeless classics, Myntra's iPhone app is your ultimate shopping companion. Five stars without hesitation!

title: Amazing Shopping Experience with Myntra App
text_original:
Myntra has completely transformed my online shopping experience! The app is incredibly user-friendly, making browsing through a wide range of clothing, footwear, and accessories a breeze. The interface is clean and intuitive, with features like easy search options, personalized recommendations, and detailed filters that help me find exactly what I’m looking for.

One thing I love is the variety of brands and products available. Whether I’m shopping for high-end fashion or budget-friendly deals, Myntra never disappoints. The frequent sales and discounts are a bonus, and I’ve saved so much with their exclusive offers.

Delivery is quick and hassle-free, with real-time tracking that keeps me updated. The return policy is one of the best I’ve encountered — simple and quick, with no questions asked. The customer support is responsive and always ready to help with any issues.

Overall, Myntra is my go-to app for all things fashion. Highly recommended for anyone who loves trendy styles and a seamless shopping experience!

title: Myntra shopping
text_original:

One of the standout features is how fast the app loads and processes payments. The checkout process is seamless, and the multiple payment options are really convenient. I also appreciate the personalized recommendations, which actually help me discover products I need instead of random suggestions.

Shipping is always timely, and tracking orders right from the app is a breeze. I’ve never had any issues with deliveries, and the customer support is responsive and helpful whenever I have any questions or concerns.

The app also frequently offers great deals and discounts, making it a go-to for all my shopping needs. Overall, it’s a fantastic app that saves me both time and money. Highly recommend it for anyone who loves convenient and hassle-free online shopping!

title: Third class customer support
text_original:
The worst online shopping experience I have ever had.

I placed an order for 3 products on Myntra. Only 2 products were actually delivered, yet the app shows that all 3 products were delivered.

To make matters worse, one of the 2 products I received was completely wrong. So I had one product missing and another product incorrectly delivered. The value of both products is approximately ₹2,500 each, meaning I am effectively facing a loss of around ₹5,000.

I raised complaints for both issues, expecting a basic resolution: a refund for the product I never received and a return/refund or exchange for the wrong product that was delivered. Instead, Myntra simply repeated that they had “checked everything from their end” and that their investigation was complete. They essentially refused to take responsibility and closed the matter.

The worst part is that Myntra’s investigation seems to be based entirely on their own internal records, while the customer is simply expected to accept the loss. I received the wrong product, one product was never delivered, and Myntra’s solution was basically: “We have checked from our end, so there is nothing more we can do.”

This is completely unacceptable. I trusted Myntra and ended up potentially losing ₹5,000 because of their delivery/fulfilment failure, while their customer support refused to provide any meaningful resolution.

I have been a customer of Myntra, but after this experience, I will never shop from Myntra again. There are plenty of other platforms available. If Myntra can simply deny a genuine complaint and leave a customer to bear a ₹5,000 loss, then there is absolutely no reason to trust this platform.

title: DONT BUY

I am sharing this experience so that other customers are aware of the risks involved. Customers spend their hard-earned money and expect accountability, transparency, and support when issues arise. Unfortunately, my experience with Myntra has been the complete opposite.
Very disappointing and highly unprofessional service.

title: Help & support should not be fully automated, there should be an option to speak to a real person.
text_original:
Earlier, chat and call support used to connect us with real people, where we could clearly explain our problems. Recently, I faced an issue with an order and the support experience was very disappointing.

I ordered a blanket, but it was delivered in a completely different color than shown in the photos. The color looked bad, so I decided to return it. I placed a return request, but when the delivery partner came for pickup, I was in the office. He did not call me, and I did not have his contact number. As a result, the return was cancelled and marked as an attempt failed.

I placed another return request, but the same issue happened again. The delivery partner reached my home when I was not there. There was no prior confirmation of the pickup date—on the Myntra app it only shows an end date, not the exact pickup day. We received a WhatsApp message only a few hours before the pickup attempt, which is not sufficient.

Now I want to return the order, but for that, I need the delivery partner to call me when he reaches so I can ask him to collect the return from my neighbours.

After facing these issues, I tried reaching out through the Myntra Help section, but this is where the real problem lies. The chat support is fully automated, and my issue is not listed among the available options, so I received no help. I also tried the “Call me back” option, but that did not work either.

Since delivery attempts can fail due to genuine reasons, Myntra should either share the delivery partner’s contact number in the app or make it mandatory for them to call if the customer is not at home. Additionally, the Help & Support section should not be fully automated—there should be an option to talk to a real person for such issues.

Extremely disappointed with Myntra's customer service. I ordered a product worth ₹1,199, but received a damaged/wrong item. After returning it, instead of refunding the amount to my original payment method, Myntra credited it as Myntra Cash without my consent.

I paid a total of ₹1,232 (including platform and delivery charges), and since the mistake was entirely on Myntra's side, I expected a full refund to my bank account. I contacted customer support multiple times, and every time I was told that the issue would be looked into. However, no resolution has been provided.

Now, when I try to contact customer care, I'm forced to speak only with an automated bot. There is no option to connect with a human agent or escalate the complaint. The bot simply repeats the same responses and offers no real support.

This kind of customer service is unacceptable. Please improve your refund policy and provide access to real customer support instead of trapping customers with automated responses.

title: Aniket Sharma
text_original: Myntra is one of the best online shopping platforms I’ve used. The app is easy to navigate, and the variety of brands and styles is impressive. I especially appreciate Myntra’s smooth return and exchange process—quick pickups and fast refunds make shopping completely stress-free. Their frequent sales and discounts offer great value for money, and the overall experience feels convenient and enjoyable. Myntra has become my go-to destination for fashion and everyday essentials.

title: Defective Product- Dishonest Pickup- No Customer Support — Myntra Failed Completely
text_original:
My experience with Myntra has been outright unacceptable. They sent me a clearly used, wear-and-tear defective product. That alone is bad enough — but the return experience was even worse.

The pickup partner’s behaviour was shockingly unprofessional. He called claiming he was at the gate. When I asked him to come to the reception gate (where pickups and deliveries always happen), he agreed. I waited at reception for over 20 minutes. His phone was continuously unreachable. When he finally answered, he bluntly said he was still at the original gate and refused to come to reception, falsely claiming delivery partners are not allowed there — which is completely untrue and contradicts every previous pickup experience.

This is not a one-off incident. It has happened multiple times. The pattern is the same: they call, ignore instructions, disappear, and then mark the pickup as “customer not available.” It feels deliberate and dishonest.

What makes it worse is Myntra’s so-called customer support. There is no proper way to escalate such issues. No real email support. No human assistance. Just an endless loop of bots repeating scripted options that don’t even cover real problems. The “request a callback” option is equally useless — another bot that cannot understand or resolve anything. The result: your money is stuck and you have no channel to be heard.

Service quality has clearly deteriorated. There are plenty of better online shopping platforms and brand websites that actually value customers. Based on repeated poor experiences, I strongly recommend avoiding Myntra altogether.

title: Fashion at Your Fingertips – Myntra Review
text_original:
Myntra is one of India’s leading online fashion and lifestyle platforms, offering a wide variety of clothing, footwear, accessories, and beauty products for men, women, and kids. It stands out for its trendy collections, user-friendly app, and smooth shopping experience.

The platform regularly offers exciting deals, discounts, and seasonal sales, making branded fashion more affordable. Product filters, size guides, and customer reviews make it easier to find the right items. Delivery is generally fast, and the packaging is neat and professional.

Myntra’s return and exchange policy is hassle-free, with doorstep pickup and quick refunds. The app also features a wishlist, style recommendations, and personalized feeds to enhance the shopping journey.

However, during sale periods, users may experience delayed deliveries or out-of-stock issues. Still, Myntra’s customer service usually resolves concerns promptly.

In summary, Myntra is a go-to destination for fashion lovers looking for variety, quality, and convenience—all in one place.

title: Sand les
text_original:
I recently purchased Beech sandals, and overall, they have been an excellent addition to my footwear collection. From comfort to design, these sandals deliver a well-balanced experience that justifies a full five-star rating.

First, comfort is the standout feature. The footbed is well-cushioned and provides good arch support, making the sandals suitable for long hours of wear. Whether used for daily errands, college, or casual outings, they do not cause foot fatigue. The sole is flexible yet sturdy, allowing natural foot movement while still offering adequate shock absorption.

In terms of design, Beech sandals strike a perfect balance between simplicity and style. The clean, minimal look makes them versatile enough to pair with jeans, trousers, dresses, or ethnic wear. The straps are thoughtfully designed—neither too tight nor too loose—and they hold the foot securely without causing friction or blisters. The finish looks neat and premium, especially considering the price range.

The material quality is another strong point. The upper material feels durable, and the stitching is clean and firm, suggesting good longevity. The sole has a non-slip texture, which provides confidence while walking on smooth or slightly wet surfaces. Even after regular use, the sandals retain their shape and appearance.

Durability has been impressive so far. Despite frequent use, there are no signs of sole wear, strap loosening, or discomfort. They are easy to clean and maintain, which is a big plus for everyday footwear.

Finally, the value for money is excellent. Beech sandals offer comfort, durability, and style at a reasonable price, making them a smart purchase for anyone looking for reliable daily-wear sandals.

Overall, Beech sandals are comfortable, stylish, durable, and affordable. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for practical yet elegant footwear for regular use.

title: Don’t buy anything from MYNTRA !!

Myntra is a disappointing app. I recently ordered a shirt from them, but it arrived with stains on it. I immediately raised a complaint and initiated a return. When the delivery agent came to pick it up, he initially took the shirt, but shortly after, he returned and said that the shirt had stains and he didn’t have the approval to pick it up. He said he was cancelling the pickup and handed the shirt back to my mother, who wasn’t aware of the situation. He also took the invoice and left.
When I contacted Myntra customer care again, they apologized and said I had already mentioned the issue, and that this should not have happened. They initiated another pickup request, but it got canceled again a short while later.
This entire experience has been frustrating. I would advise others not to purchase anything from Myntra

title: Wrong pricing and no support from customer care
text_original:
I recently had a disappointing experience with Myntra. I had added Adidas SL72 shoes (size 8) to my wishlist, where the price was clearly showing as ₹5,499. But the moment I tried adding them to my cart, the price jumped to ₹6,999.

I called customer care to clarify, and they asked me to send screenshots over email and told me it would take 24 hours to review. When I asked if I could still purchase the product at the wishlist price of ₹5,499, the response was “No, it depends on the current product price at the time of purchase.”

This makes no sense — if the app shows a lower price in the wishlist, why can’t customers buy it at that rate? There’s no proper resolution offered, which leaves customers frustrated and confused. Myntra should fix this glitch or at least honor the price shown in the wishlist.

The delivery agent came on 5th day from the original scheduled date. Don’t know what they were doing till then. I had to refuse the delivery. Will not use the scammer myntra from now on. They just ruined the experience. Once the business becomes successful, they start taking customers for granted.

title: Customer Support is a Nightmare
text_original:
If you have to return a product that is not the right size or is faulty, you’re okay. 

But God forbid if you get the wrong product - you’ve lost your money. 

I ordered green circular hoop earrings. I got gold earrings with a completely different design. The product was wrong. I went to customer support and clicked on “wrong product, initiate return.” After that, nothing went right. The pickup team picked up the product and matched it with their database. Since the earrings don’t match, the pickup failed. They’re now telling me that they’ll come again to pick up the right product. But here’s the thing, there is no right product. They already picked up the earrings. There is nothing to pick up. Customer support keeps telling me to wait for 48 hours and they told me to talk to the delivery agent because they don’t have the delivery agent’s number since it’s encrypted for them. They keep telling me “they understand my concern and they’re doing the best to solve the problem” but they’re just reading a script. The agents don’t even understand the problem. 

A classic wrong product issue cannot be solved my Myntra. How they managed to become the leading clothes online store, I’ll never know.

title: Rating myntra
text_original:
I'm thrilled to give Myntra a four stars! For anyone looking to stay trendy, this is the go-to fashion app.
What really makes Myntra stand out is the sheer variety of brands. Whether I'm looking for high-street fast fashion or something classic, I find it all here. The app interface is sleek, easy to navigate, and the high-quality product images and detailed descriptions make shopping hassle-free.
But the real game-changer is the convenience: the lightning-fast delivery, and the absolutely seamless returns and exchange policy. It takes the risk out of online shopping.
If you love fashion and value a premium shopping experience, look no further than Myntra. Highly, highly recommended!

title: If You Busk Cream
text_original:
The If You Musk body cream is such a hidden gem from Bath & Body Works! The texture is luxuriously thick but absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feel, which makes it perfect for both day and night use. The fragrance is warm, musky, and slightly sensual – not overpowering, just the right balance of cozy and sophisticated. It layers beautifully with perfumes or can stand alone as a soft signature scent.

My skin feels incredibly hydrated and smooth for hours, and I love how the scent lingers gently without being too strong. If you’re someone who enjoys musky, skin-like fragrances with a creamy undertone, this one is absolutely worth adding to your collection.

title: Ultimate Comfort & Style
text_original:
I've tried multiple underwear brands over the years, but DaMENSCH truly stands out. The fabric is incredibly soft and breathable — perfect for all-day wear, whether you're lounging at home or out and about. The fit is snug without being too tight, and it doesn't lose shape even after multiple washes. The waistband is sturdy yet gentle on the skin, which is a big plus.

What I really appreciate is the attention to detail and quality — it feels premium from the moment you put it on. Definitely a go-to choice now. Highly recommended for anyone who values comfort, durability, and a clean, stylish look!

title: Great purchase
text_original: I had a fantastic shopping experience with Myntra! The variety of products available is impressive, catering to all fashion needs. I ordered several items, and each arrived on time, perfectly packaged. The quality of the clothes exceeded my expectations, with accurate sizes and vibrant colors just as shown on the website. The user-friendly interface made browsing and purchasing a breeze. Additionally, their customer service was responsive and helpful when I had a query about my order. Myntra has definitely become my go-to for online fashion shopping!

title: Terrible Experience with Myntra – Repeated Delays and Cancellations

The customer support is completely useless. The chat support just tells you to call, while the call support sends you back to chat without solving anything! As for emails, they’re basically ignored—I haven’t had a single proper response to any of my complaints. It’s like Myntra’s support team doesn’t exist.

I can no longer trust this platform for reliable deliveries, and the way they handle customer service is an absolute nightmare. Save yourself the headache and shop elsewhere if you’re looking for a hassle-free experience
